|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Reave''' is a [[melee]] [[attack]] [[active skill|skill]] that deals damage in a small area in front of you, gaining more [[area of effect]] with each continuous hit. The bonus AoE is gradually lost while not hitting anything. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Dual Wielding]]''': Using Reave while dual wielding will alternate the weapon used for attacking. * '''More [[area of effect]]''': This is a local multiplicative bonus and applies only to Reave and {{il|Vaal Reave}}. At 4 stacks, Reave has a total of 200% more area of effect which ends up at 41 radius for level 20 gem. Area of effect spreads out in a 135 degree arc. * '''Stacks''': If no enemy is hit with Reave or Vaal Reave for three seconds, stacks are lost incrementally. The maximum number of stacks that can be applied is 4, but any number of stacks can be maintained. This allows it to be possible to maintain 8 stacks by first using Vaal Reave. * '''[[Duration]]''': Currently there is no way to increase its duration. * '''Interaction between different Reave gems and {{il|Vaal Reave}}''': Bonus maximum stages from Vaal Reave apply to ''all'' socketed Reave gems. This allows using a {{il|Vaal Reave}} gem for additional maximum stages while a separate Reave gem is used for damage, such as one imbued with a support in Mirage league. {{il|Enhance Support}}, {{il|Awakened Enhance Support}} and {{il|Eclipse Support}} can further increase maximum stages by granting additional quality to Vaal Reave. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Radius |c1_header = +x metres to radius |c1_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c1_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1, scaling up to 10 at gem level 20 (previously 6 at all gem levels). * Now has 232% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 170%), scaling up to 534% at gem level 20 (previously 250%). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides +0-2 to maximum Stages, instead of 0-10% increased Attack Speed. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * Reave now has 170% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 150%), up to 250% at gem level 20 (previously 225%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now deals 225% of Base Damage, and has 225% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 180%). }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Now deals base weapon damage and has an added damage effectiveness of 150% at gem level 1 (from 135%), up to 180% at gem level 20 (from 155%). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative gem [[quality]]. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 135% at gem level 1 (from 100%), up to 155% at gem level 20 (from 138%). * The base skill radius is now 2 units larger. * Now gains up to +2 radius at gem level 20 (from +4). * Now loses stages incrementally after a short period without hitting anything, rather than all at once. }} {{Version history table row|3.1.0| * Radius has been increased from 17 to 20, bringing it up to 24 at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Reave gains 1 additional unit of radius every 5 levels. * No longer gain increased area of effect radius. * Now gains 50% more area of effect per stage, instead of 20% more radius per stage. }} {{Version history table row|2.4.0| * 16% more damage at gem level 20.
